card.name: Linking words in diabetes warnings
card.fires_on: Linking words like "to" or "with" (and the start of "Insulin") in diabetes warning text, after "due to" or "in patients" near hypoglycemia or insulin pump wording.

modes.label: Due to before a cause
modes.description: The word "to" in "due to" in hyperglycemia or hypoglycemia warning headings.

modes.label: Insulin pump heading
modes.description: The start or middle of "Insulin" in the pump malfunction heading.

modes.label: In patients with
modes.description: "with" after "in patients" when listing groups with reduced hypoglycemia awareness.
